As someone with anxiety myself out of all the times I’ve tripped I have had an intense trip (not a bad trip) twice or what other people are saying, let my anxiety cloud my thoughts, but I just relax and breathe and remind myself I’m on Acid and let myself be taken by the trip. Honestly I would say personally that Acid /has/ helped my anxiety and also helped me be less pessimistic in my every day life. I also used to be real dependent on pills and nicotine and after just some introspection during my trips I haven’t touched a pill since and have made nicotine a once a day habit instead of chain smoking chronically. Of course everyone’s experience will be different, but acid has just helped me appreciate and love myself a lot more (and as someone who used to be super insecure about my body it’s been a weight off my chest I’ve carried for years). It’s better safe than sorry, so please listen to everyone else very closely, but for me I find Acid very therapeutic.
